jobs.name: ask-verifier
jobs.prompt: Ask verifier. The owner has open asks (things agents are waiting on them for). Your only job: find the ones they have evidently already done and close them with evidence, so they leave the owner's board without the owner having to say so. Steps: (1) `lifectl asks` — consider only asks whose check_hint is non-empty; skip decisions/questions (only the owner or the thread can close those). (2) For each, check the hint with read-only tools (lifectl obs/threads/status, `lifectl api GET /api/v1/…`, git log, ls) — e.g. an observation that arrived, an install that succeeded (ops/logs/app-install.log), a file that now exists. (3) Evidence is clear → `lifectl ask <id> done "verifier: <what you saw>"` (that posts into the thread so its agent continues). Ambiguous or no evidence → leave it alone; never guess, never dismiss. (4) Your final message must be ONLY the JSON envelope described above — no prose, no markdown, no backticks. Put one line per ask you closed (or 'nothing verifiable') in `summary`, and leave `findings` and `needs_you` empty: this job never raises asks of its own.
